description: Binary assertion tests for /acceptance-test skill output quality

tests.name: guard_generates_trip_non_trip_pair
tests.description: Given a guard requirement, must generate both TRIP and NON-TRIP test skeletons.
tests.prompt: Run /acceptance-test for this contract requirement. Generate test skeletons for §2.3.5 LiquidityGate book snapshot staleness check.

assertions.check: Output contains a TRIP test function
Output contains a NON-TRIP test function
TRIP test asserts dispatch_count == 0
NON-TRIP test asserts dispatch_count == 1
Output mentions BookSnapshotStale reject reason

tests.name: latch_uses_latch_reason
tests.description: Latch requirement should use latch_reason for causality proof, not just dispatch_count.
tests.prompt: Run /acceptance-test for this contract requirement. Generate tests for §2.4.1 WebSocket book gap latch.

assertions.check: Output asserts latch_reason in the TRIP test
Output mentions WsBookGap
Output includes a reconcile/clear test (latch cleared after reconcile)
Output has #[test] attribute
Output references §2.4.1 in test docstring

tests.name: intent_classification_covers_all_cases
tests.description: Intent classification has 4 cases. Tests should cover unknown/missing as OPEN.
tests.prompt: Run /acceptance-test for this contract requirement. Generate tests for §2.1.3 intent classification.

assertions.check: Output tests unknown intent classified as OPEN
Output tests reduce_only=true classified as CLOSE
Output tests replace order treated as OPEN
Output contains assert_eq! or assert! macros
Output mentions IntentClass enum or classification

tests.name: staleness_guard_has_at_registration
tests.description: Must include AT registration text for CONTRACT.md, not just test code.
tests.prompt: Run /acceptance-test for this contract requirement. Generate tests for §2.2.2 policy staleness.

assertions.check: Output includes AT registration text for CONTRACT.md
Output mentions PolicyStale reject reason
Output has force_other_gates_pass or equivalent isolation
Output includes both TRIP and NON-TRIP
Output references §2.2.2 in docstring or comment

tests.name: multi_condition_generates_separate_tests
tests.description: Guard with 3 conditions should generate at least 3 TRIP tests (one per condition) plus NON-TRIP.
tests.prompt: Run /acceptance-test for this contract requirement. Generate tests for §2.3.8 pre-trade risk check with 3 conditions.

assertions.check: Output has at least 3 TRIP tests (one per condition)
Output mentions all 3 reject reasons
Output has at least 1 NON-TRIP test
Each test uses assert_eq on reject_reason (causality)
Output references §2.3.8
